title: Kingdom of Kush
summary: Nubian kingdom on the Nile in what is now Sudan, dated from about 1069 BCE to 350 CE, with Napata as first capital. According to World History Encyclopedia the capital moved to Meroë around 590 BCE, and the kingdom ended after an Aksumite invasion c. 330 CE. UNESCO calls Meroë its heartland.

uncertainty.note: World History Encyclopedia gives c. 1069 BCE to 350 CE; UNESCO dates Kush as a major power from the 8th century BC to the 4th century AD.
